driveSpeed.note: Logged drive time ÷ the drawing's time; 0.83-1.25 on 2 Nov (1.5 was the light chassis).

spinUpS.note: Median of 83 spin-ups to launch speed; 0.9-2.1 s, slowest on a low battery.

volleyS.source: plan (mentor, 12 Nov 2026), from the Belding films: the fourth ball leaves 2.0-2.5 s after the gate opens
volleyS.note: A volley that ends on its fourth ball. With the set 3.5 s feed running out, as at Belding when the shot counter undercounted, it measured 3.6-4.6 s, median 4.0.

cellCheckS.note: Quick-check limit for "Wait for TIP or CELL up" on arrival: the camera saw the CELL up 0.22-0.44 s after the drive ended.

intakeFullS.note: Last piece a median 1.5 s after the push starts, plus about 0.4 s to latch full.

tipStartS.source: Belding films, 7 Nov 2026, for a volley that ends on its fourth ball
tipStartS.note: With tipSwingS 1.6: the last ball to CellUp is the films' 4.1 s for a CELL at its tipping weight (a counted feed ends 0.1 s after its last ball). Was 1.4 with the 4.0 s volley.

tipSwingS.source: measured, Belding Qualifier video and L-NoCross logs, 7 Nov 2026
tipSwingS.note: Swing 1.0-1.4 s, then 0.3-0.5 s for the camera to read the CELL up. With tipStartS: last ball to CellUp about 4.2 s.

tipLoad.note: Field Setup Guide 12.3: an empty raised CELL tips on 8 POLLEN.

startLoad.note: 3 NECTAR start in the raised CELL, so the 3rd POLLEN tips it.

volleyLoad.note: 4 POLLEN if every shot lands; lower it for misses.

pickFlowerS.source: measured, 19429 and 20245 Auto logs, 29 Oct-14 Nov 2026 (events/2026-11-belding and logs/*)
pickFlowerS.note: PickFlower step, start to end: median 3.58 s over 107 Auto picks. The lane read full a median 2.6 s after the step began (61 picks, 1.5-4.7 s; 2.7 s at Belding); 43 never read full and ran a median 3.7 s. The guard still plans 4.0 s (AutoRegistration.PICK_FLOWER_TYPICAL_S).

gardenGatherS.source: measured, 19429 TeleOp button gathers, 18 Nov 2026 (logs/2026-11-18-19429-RC), with the 19 Nov GardenGather defaults: no Auto gather yet, so re-measure
gardenGatherS.note: Five gathers that ran to the end: 2.26-2.50 s without their line-up, which an Auto's gather does not do. Was 4.4, the median of ten Auto gathers of 3-14 Nov (nine with the old 1.5 s dwell). The guard plans 3.0 s (AutoRegistration.GARDEN_GATHER_TYPICAL_S).

partnerTipLagS.source: measured, Belding Qualifier films, 7 Nov 2026 (re-measured 11 Nov)
partnerTipLagS.note: Partner's last ball leaving to our CellUp, as a give-up limit: catches 11 of 13 at-weight TIPs (median lag 4.1 s; 4.5 caught 9; 6.7 catches all).
